notes: Captured from the live GVP WFS (GetFeature with the adapter's facts-only propertyName list) and trimmed from 1,214 to 155 volcanoes: an even sample of every GVP region in proportion to its size, plus well-known volcanoes (Etna, Vesuvius, Kilauea, Fuji, Krakatau, Merapi, Popocatepetl, St. Helens, Eyjafjallajokull, Erebus, Nyiragongo, Pinatubo, …) and border volcanoes with two-country strings. Features are unmodified; totalFeatures/numberMatched/numberReturned were adjusted to 155. The malformed variant was authored by hand from the same schema.
